notes: Built from simulated machines only. Nothing here has been checked on a real machine.
Accelerometer, gyro and IMU readings only: the simulators ran with the microphone, thermal camera and room sensor absent, because that is what the device has today.
No fault_classifier in the model file. The classifier is trained per machine today, and retraining it in calibration is not designed yet.
No baseline in the model file: the outside-normal levels belong to one machine.
Readings named in the model file's calibration.hold (time of day, trends, IMU temperature) cannot be refitted from a 5-minute calibration.

A research pass on the simulators found that a conveyor entry calibrated on the server rack raised no false alarms and caught none of five faults. So using an entry on another type of machine is unproven.
Built from 64800 seconds of running in all (18.0 hours over 6 sources); the last 15 percent of each source was held out for the threshold.
The threshold (122.6) is 45.3 times the median held-out score (2.706). It is never below the highest held-out score, which site disturbances push up.
